name: When should I consider replacing my toilet instead of repairing a leak?

mainEntity.name: When should I consider replacing my toilet instead of repairing a leak?

acceptedAnswer.text: Consider replacing your toilet if the leak is due to a cracked bowl or tank, or if the toilet is very old and frequently needs repairs. While a cracked component might sometimes be sealed, it's often a temporary fix, and a new toilet provides a more reliable, long-term solution. Additionally, if you're looking to upgrade to a more water-efficient model, replacement can save water and money on utility bills in the long run. We can help assess the best option during a service call.
acceptedAnswer.description: Replace your toilet if it has a cracked bowl or tank, is frequently breaking down, or if you want to upgrade to a more water-efficient model.
